_doc: Expected site routes per bag test (site fwd_register_base_rate_interest), from each test's construction: 'on' counters must equal 'exact' and be >= 'min'; every recognised call is specialised or residual; in 'invalid' mode every recognised call is residual (forced), none specialised, as many recognised as in 'on'. Rule found in the pilot (evidence/s1-2026-11-24/bagtest-pilot, first version of this file expected one more call in t1-t5) and checked by t0: the first call of a run, made before anything was added to &forward_base_rate_interest, is not offered to the site (the space token is unbound and CeTTa runs that match as a plain-symbol Prolog-predicate query, a branch before the hook), so t1-t5 recognise their calls minus one; t0 adds and removes a row first and recognises all of its 3 calls.
